To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the EXCLUSIVE INDEX approach allows to describe the population of residual nuclei from light-ion induced reactions in the whole energy range of the compound nucleus formation up to about 100 MeV bombarding energies.

the present version of the EXCLUSIVE INDEX (EIX) model is capable of predicting the population of 5 residual nuclei (including the primary compound nucleus) through two stages of preequilibrium decay, and it can be applied to reactions induced by light ions (p,d,3He,4He) on a wide range of target nuclei (Z=30-94) at energies up to 170MeV.

the EXCLUSIVE INDEX approach is a powerful tool to analyze the excitation functions of reactions with light projectiles, that the two-nucleon evaporation is an important mechanism in the preequilibirum phase, that the angular momentum decouplings are essential in the preequilbrium and compound nucleus phases, and that the EXCLUSIVE approach is a useful tool in nuclear astrophysics.
